title: Photosynthesis | The Dr. Binocs Show | Learn Videos For Kids
summary: Dr. Binocs introduces photosynthesis, the process plants use to make their own food. He explains that the word comes from the Greek 'photo' (light) and 'synthesis' (putting together), and that plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make food. He describes how leaves take in carbon dioxide through tiny openings called stomata, how roots absorb water and nutrients, and how chloroplasts turn these into sugar and oxygen. The video ends with trivia: chlorophyll is the green pigment in chloroplasts that makes plants green, and plants are called the lungs of the world because they give out the oxygen humans breathe.
